# ParticleSpawn

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct ParticleSpawn
```

One particle placed exactly, for patterns the effect's random values don't describe. Values left null are sampled from the effect.
